title: json_decode decodes numbers outside the integer range
summary: JSON integers outside the platform's integer range may be decoded to floating point by default, and JSON_BIGINT_AS_STRING may preserve their decimal text.
detail: On 64-bit PHP, 9223372036854775808 exceeds PHP_INT_MAX. Floating point output is insufficient to prove the original text when it is necessary to preserve each bit of the record ID.
boundary: This option targets large integers; exponents and decimals still follow floating point parsing.
relevance: Determine whether the difference between two long digital records comes from the original file or the decoder.
